description: This file defines a custom logger class 'ArgillaLogger' for integrating with Argilla, a data annotation platform. It handles batching, serialization of logs, and communication with Argilla's API, including methods for validation, data preparation, and asynchronous batch sending.

classes.name: ArgillaLogger
classes.description: A custom batch logger for sending logs to Argilla, supporting batch processing, validation, and both synchronous and asynchronous logging methods.

methods.name: is_serializable(value)
methods.description: Checks if a value is serializable by ensuring it's not one of the specified non-serializable types.

methods.name: validate_argilla_transformation_object( self, argilla_transformation_object: Dict[str, Any] )
methods.description: Validates that the transformation object is a dictionary with values supported for payload processing.

methods.name: ArgillaCredentialsObject get_credentials_from_env( self, argilla_api_key: Optional[str], argilla_dataset_name: Optional[str], argilla_base_url: Optional[str], )
methods.description: Retrieves Argilla credentials and dataset information, possibly querying the Argilla API to resolve dataset IDs.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] get_chat_messages( self, payload: StandardLoggingPayload )
methods.description: Extracts chat messages from the payload, normalizing the format for logging.

methods.name: str get_str_response(self, payload: StandardLoggingPayload)
methods.description: Extracts and formats the response string from the payload.

methods.name: Optional[ArgillaItem] _prepare_log_data( self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time )
methods.description: Prepares the data payload for logging based on the transformation configuration.

methods.name: _send_batch(self)
methods.description: Sends the current batch of logs to Argilla API in a bulk request.

methods.name: log_success_event(self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time)
methods.description: Handles a successful log event, possibly sampling, and queues data for batch sending.

methods.name: async_log_success_event(self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time)
methods.description: Asynchronous version of handling a successful log event and queuing data.

methods.name: async_log_failure_event(self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time)
methods.description: Asynchronous handler for logging a failure event.

methods.name: async_send_batch(self)
methods.description: Asynchronously sends accumulated logs to Argilla API
